Notepad
How to type
  • 09:00-11:00 what from 09:00 until 11:00
  • 14:00 what from 14:00, about 1 hour (shorter if the next thing starts sooner)
  • 14:00 2h what or 14:00 45m what a set length
  • A line without a time: a note for the line above it (or for the day, at the top)
  • or 14:00-15:00 what Plan B for the line above; choose A or B in the plan
  • Chinese in a line (豫园, an address) gives it Show driver
  • Fixed points are not in the notepad: they stay put
